notes: Job assignment, weekly chapel rotation and photo evidence in the report.
new: Job assignment: the priest, founder or admin gives each crew member Cleaning, Preparation and/or Closing. Crew can only tick tasks in their own jobs.
Chapel rotation: the two crew swap CITE and SAC every week. The Chapel tab shows who is in charge. The other chapel's crew can still help with Mass preparation.
Photo evidence: when all tasks are done, tap Add photo, then Share report to send the report and photos to your group chat. Each chapel has its own report.
